body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: Three abandoned small freight wagons form a patched refuge just inside a rock shelter. Removed wheels, stitched tarp roofs and a low cooking hearth. A dark narrow cleft behind them leads down. No war or travelling army. COMPOSITION: Low side view through the gap between two wheels; the wagons create a thin inhabited horizon. COLOR SCRIPT: ash gray, near-black aubergine shadows, oxblood fabric, low warm lamps. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
